description: Canada’s Energy Future 2026 - Cost and Performance Parameters for Electricity Generation and Storage Technologies is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. The Canada Energy Regulator’s (CER) Canada’s Energy Future 2026: Cost and Performance Parameters for Electricity Generation and Storage Technologies dataset provides the assumptions underpinning the electricity sector projections in Canada’s Energy Future 2026: Energy Supply and Demand Projections to 2050. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. Its tags are Canada's Energy Future 2026, EF2026, Technology Costs, Electricity, Energy Storage. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
